perfume.answer: Kenya Airways lists aerosols such as hair spray, perfume and alcohol-based medicines among items not allowed in hand baggage; check them in, up to 0.5 kg/L per article and 2.0 kg/L in total.

faq: Can I carry perfume in my Kenya Airways hand baggage?
The Restricted Items list says aerosols such as hair spray and perfume are not allowed in hand baggage and advises checking them in, within 0.5 kg/L per article and 2.0 kg/L in total.
Are flammable liquids banned on Kenya Airways?
Yes. Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives, and compressed gases like butane and lighter fuel, are prohibited in checked and hand baggage.
